summary:
Beep! Beep! Let's Explore! — Oppy's Little Adventure is an interactive digital storybook designed to introduce children aged 7–12 to NASA's historic space exploration equipment through fun, engaging storytelling.

Developed using Figma, the project brings space exploration to life through colorful chibi characters, short interactive dialogues, and educational quizzes. Children begin their adventure with Oppy, NASA's Opportunity rover, discovering evidence of ancient water on Mars and learning why its mission ended.

The adventure also introduces Spirit, Opportunity's twin rover, before allowing children to explore two human perspectives: a NASA scientist studying historical moonquake recordings and three astronauts discovering the Surveyor 3 lunar lander.

Inspired by NASA's "Abandoned but Not Forgotten" challenge, our project transforms scientific information into an accessible learning experience. It highlights how equipment left on the Moon and Mars continues to contribute to scientific knowledge, encouraging young explorers to appreciate the lasting legacy of past space missions.
details:
GAMEPLAY FEATURE

In Beep! Beep! Let's Explore! — Oppy's Little Adventure, children embark on a fun and exciting journey to discover the incredible stories behind NASA's abandoned space equipment! Players begin on the main page before meeting Oppy, a cheerful Mars rover whose real name is Opportunity. Through interactive storytelling, children discover why NASA sent Oppy to Mars, how he found evidence of ancient water, and how a massive dust storm eventually brought his mission to an end.

Afterward, players explore different perspectives, including Mars, Luna (the Moon), a NASA Scientist, and a team of three Astronauts. In Mars's POV, children meet Spirit and Opportunity, the twin rovers that explored different parts of Mars. Meanwhile, Luna's POV introduces NASA's historic lunar equipment, including Surveyor 3 and the Apollo seismometers.

In the NASA Scientist's POV, players discover how scientists study moonquakes using historical recordings from instruments left on the Moon. Through the Astronauts' POV, children join three Apollo 12 astronauts as they investigate Surveyor 3, discovering how its camera and soil scoop helped NASA prepare for lunar exploration and why some of its components were brought back to Earth.

Each tap reveals a short dialogue bubble, allowing children to enjoy the story at their own pace. To wrap up the adventure, players complete two interactive trivia quizzes with two questions each, reinforcing what they have learned about Oppy's mission and scientific discoveries!

PROBLEM-SOLVING SKILLS

Players learn by exploring scientific discoveries, cause and effect, and the challenges faced by NASA's space equipment. Through Oppy's journey, children discover how unusual Martian rocks provided evidence of ancient water and how dust storms affected the rover's solar power.

By exploring different perspectives, players learn how scientists use seismic recordings to understand moonquakes, how Surveyor 3 investigated lunar soil, and why certain space missions eventually ended. Each discovery encourages critical thinking, observation, and scientific reasoning, helping children understand how scientists interpret evidence from space.

By following these adventures, players connect fun storytelling with real NASA science, discovering how machines left behind on the Moon and Mars continue to contribute to our understanding of space.

ELEMENTS

Interactive Learning: Players engage with multiple storytelling perspectives, interactive dialogue bubbles, character selections, and educational quizzes to discover how NASA's historic equipment contributed to space exploration.

Creative Storytelling: The adventure blends verified NASA facts with fictional characters and playful conversations, bringing silent space equipment back to life while making complex scientific concepts fun and easy to understand.

Vibrant Visuals: Colorful illustrations, expressive chibi characters, Martian landscapes, lunar environments, and simple animations bring the story to life, making space science visually exciting and enjoyable for children aged 7–12.

WHAT TOOL DID WE USE TO CREATE OUR GAME?

Our team used Figma, a powerful prototyping tool, to design and develop our interactive digital storybook. Through Figma's collaborative features, we created colorful visuals, interactive pages, character selection screens, and smooth storytelling transitions.

We also used Canva and Freepik as supporting platforms for graphics and visual design resources, while ChatGPT assisted with character illustrations, storyline development, and content refinement. Scientific information was researched using official NASA resources provided for the challenge.

Tools and Resources:

  1. Figma — https://www.figma.com/
  2. Magnific — https://www.magnific.com/
  3. Canva — https://www.canva.com/
  4. ChatGPT — https://chatgpt.com/
  5. NASA Science — https://science.nasa.gov/

GOALS

The main goal of Beep! Beep! Let's Explore! — Oppy's Little Adventure is to make learning about NASA's historic space exploration equipment engaging, interactive, and educational for children aged 7–12.

Inspired by the "Abandoned but Not Forgotten" challenge, the story encourages curiosity about science and space while helping children understand why NASA sent robotic explorers and scientific instruments to the Moon and Mars, what discoveries they made, and why their contributions remain valuable even after their missions have ended.

By combining creative storytelling, exploration, vibrant illustrations, and simple scientific explanations, the project aims to inspire young learners to appreciate NASA's past achievements and understand that even when a space explorer's journey ends, its discoveries can continue inspiring future generations!
